contributions.name: XAI explanation quality
evidence: Top-SHAP deletion AUC drop exceeds random masks for k=10,25,50 under mean and median baselines.
Within-fold rank stability: Spearman=0.6137; Jaccard top-10=0.6806.
limits: No causal claim at executable level.

contributions.name: XAI-Guided Active Learning
evidence: U+H beats Random by mean ROC-AULC 0.009260 and wins 5/5 folds.
U+H beats Uncertainty by mean ROC-AULC 0.001091 and wins 5/5 folds.
U+H uses 76 fewer labels than Random on average to validation target.
limits: XAI_full is not the best ablation; it trails U+H by 0.000719 ROC-AULC and 24 labels.
Label counts are oracle queries, not measured analyst hours.

contributions.name: PID temporal fusion
limits: Requires real dynamic reports at multiple time points, aligned sample identities and a frozen dynamic scorer.

ofs.reason: No validated common-scale normalization and weighting rule; components are reported separately.
